body: FABLE advisor implemented in emily-agent/fable.go. Two routes: GET /api/v1/emily/fable/advice (generates 3-item prioritized sprint recommendation from GOLDEN.md + recent Apples via claude-haiku) and POST /api/v1/emily/fable/execute (generates advice then files top recommendation as HEIMDAL sprint for Emily Prime to translate+queue on next cycle). IdunaClient created from env vars for Apple context + sprint submission. FableAdvice struct with FableItem{priority,title,rationale,section,effort} + summary + generated_at.
title: S16 FABLE advisor — GET /api/v1/emily/fable/advice + POST execute endpoints
